We built the marketing org before we hired the marketing leader. Now we are hiring the leader.

Curately is an AI recruiting platform with 40+ staffing customers and 9 enterprise workforce programs, and until this summer it had no marketing team at all. Since July the founder has built one out of software: seven AI marketing agents, the governance and knowledge base they run on, and the automation that runs them on a schedule.
